Planet Fitness Vineland vs Animal Paradise: Which Gym Fits You?

By the Animal Paradise coaching team · Vineland, NJ

Short answer: If you want the lowest monthly price, Planet Fitness is hard to beat. If you want heavy free weights, a sauna in every plan, childcare, a women-only area, recovery tools and coaches who prep competitors, Animal Paradise in Cumberland Mall is built for you. Plans run $60 to $80 a month, and the first coach consultation is free.

Planet Fitness is one of the most searched gym names in Vineland, and for good reason. It is cheap, simple and familiar. But cheap is not the same as right for you. This guide puts both gyms side by side so you can pick the one that matches how you actually train.

We run Animal Paradise, so we are not neutral. We have kept every claim about Planet Fitness to what the brand publishes nationally, and we tell you where they win.

Quick comparison

Planet Fitness Animal Paradise
Monthly price Classic from $15, Black Card around $25 (national pricing, varies by club) $60 to $80 a month, or $70 month to month
Fees Annual and startup fees vary by club Ask the front desk
Hours Check the Vineland club page 4AM to 12AM, every day
Heavy free weights Varies by club Arsenal, Atlantis and Rogue, heavy dumbbells, squat racks, plate-loaded machines
Functional turf Varies by club 80-foot turf
Sauna Not part of the standard offer Included with every plan
Recovery Black Card perks vary Hibernation Station: massage chairs and compression (Premium and Diamond)
Women-only area Not part of the standard offer Lioness Den, code locked (Platinum and Diamond)
Childcare Not part of the standard offer Daycare add-on, $9.99 a month
Coaching Free intro training at many clubs Personal training (separate service), first consultation free
Contest prep Not offered Coach Chuck, NPC prep and a posing room
On-site food Not offered Animal Cafe and Animal Supps
Access to other locations Black Card: any Planet Fitness One location, inside Cumberland Mall

Prices and perks at Planet Fitness change by location. Check the Vineland club page for current numbers before you sign.

Where Planet Fitness wins

Price. A Classic membership starting around $15 a month is the cheapest way to get access to cardio machines and basic strength equipment.

Travel. With a Black Card you can train at any Planet Fitness, which is handy if you travel a lot.

A low-key first step. If you have never lifted and just want treadmills and machines while you build a habit, a budget gym can work.

Where Animal Paradise wins

Serious strength equipment. We built the floor for people who lift. Heavy dumbbells, squat racks, plate-loaded machines, cable stations and an 80-foot turf mean you are rarely waiting on a single rack.

Recovery is included. Every plan comes with the sauna rooms. Premium and Diamond add the Hibernation Station with massage chairs and compression therapy. Red light therapy and tanning are on site too.

Childcare. Parents can add daycare for $9.99 a month, so you can train without finding a sitter.

A women-only space. The Lioness Den is a code-locked training area for women on the Platinum and Diamond plans.

Coaching that goes all the way to the stage. Coach Chuck preps NPC competitors, Hakim is a NASM certified trainer, and Lauren is a female coach. Personal training is a separate service, and the first consultation is free.

Fuel on site. Animal Cafe serves shakes, smoothies, acai bowls and coffee, and Animal Supps stocks over 100 brands. Both keep the same hours as the gym.

What the price difference actually buys

The gap between a budget gym and Animal Paradise is real, so look at what is inside each plan. If you would pay separately for a sauna session, childcare or recovery tools, or if you have ever left a crowded gym because the only squat rack was taken, the higher membership often works out to better value per visit.

Not sure? A day pass is $20 and a one-week pass is $40. Train here for a week, then decide.

Which gym should you choose?

Choose Planet Fitness if your top priority is the lowest monthly price, you mainly use cardio machines, or you need access to many locations.

Choose Animal Paradise if you lift heavy or want to, you want a sauna and recovery tools included, you need childcare, you want a women-only area, or you are thinking about competing.

The easiest way to know is to walk the floor. Book a free tour and see it for yourself.

Quick answers

How much is Animal Paradise compared to Planet Fitness?

Animal Paradise plans run $60 to $80 a month on a 12-month plan, or $70 month to month. Planet Fitness Classic starts around $15 a month nationally, with Black Card around $25, and fees vary by club.

Does Animal Paradise have a sauna?

Yes. Sauna rooms are included with every Animal Paradise membership.

Is Animal Paradise open 24 hours?

No. Animal Paradise is open every day from 4AM to 12AM, including weekends.

Can I try Animal Paradise before joining?

Yes. You can book a free tour, buy a $20 day pass or a $40 one-week pass.

Where is Animal Paradise in Vineland?

Inside Cumberland Mall at 3849 S Delsea Dr, Suite E000, Vineland, NJ 08360, with free parking at the door.

Does Animal Paradise have childcare?

Yes. Daycare is available as an add-on for $9.99 a month.
